notes: GrounDiff (gated Palette UNet, DSM -> DTM) + tile_range on multi-year EA data (2017-2022). Noise2Noise (Lehtinen et al., ICML 2018): half the training tiles take their target from another survey year of the same place (vertical offset removed, changed cells masked), so no year's label is treated as clean; L1 only (median-seeking under N2N). Validated against the multi-year consensus DTM. Trained from scratch.
